decision: Accept the typed research integration as a bounded synthetic compatibility milestone. It replaces process-local account instrumentation, uses actual decision-time positions, applies native entry admission/ranks and reconciled native-priced configured closes, and publishes controller evidence only with a successful account commit. All 96 diagnostic accounts match their previous frozen counterparts and reproduce byte-for-byte from source 585b484; 341 tests pass in both worktree and archive. Next qualify the exact missing historical source observations and assemble the complete historical dynamic account on every original source/cost/clock/allocation axis. No historical profit improvement or live change is established.
falsifier: Any altered original source/anchor/clock, silent missing-bar substitution, lost occupancy or controller evidence, unexplained seven-slot account change, unmatched close geometry/cost, changed account after a failed step, failed Decimal reconciliation or archive mismatch invalidates the corresponding claim. Historical dynamic accounts, gaps, canonical evidence and untouched forward results remain necessary to assess economic performance.
hypothesis: Applying native entry admissions at the true decision-position boundary can preserve native capacity and configured-exit withholding while retaining source-priced account economics.
limitations: The 96 retained account comparisons are complete one-hour synthetic prefixes, not full historical accounts. Separate tests cover complete two-day HYPE soft/hard holds and seven open terminal positions.
All source prices and provider decisions in account comparisons are programmed 2030 fixtures. Opening-price proxies retain their later source knowledge clocks and are not observed executable quotes.
Native and original configured exit disagreement fails explicitly. Full native transport, actual historical source receipts and changed-size live fills remain unqualified.

No prospective outcomes, live account outcomes, live strategy, configuration or process lifecycle were changed or evaluated. No profitable live recommendation is established.
